diagnosis: The view queries dashboards using get_objects_for_user with accept_global_perms=True. When users hold a default role with a model-level view permission in their own workspace, guardian returns all KpiDashboard objects across all tenant organizations rather than restricting results to dashboards where object-level permission was explicitly granted.
